decisions.hidden_reasoning:
**Evaluating Pokémon Choices**

I'm thinking about using Dragonite, Primarina, and Gholdengo for my lineup. Gholdengo is great against Fairy, Corviknight, and Toxapex; Primarina can take on Hydreigon, Garchomp, and Krookodile, while Dragonite has strong sweeping capabilities with Extreme Speed. I do worry about the possible threat from opposing Gardevoir towards Dragonite. Kingambit could counter Gardevoir, but Gholdengo's Steel typing helps too. I must decide which Pokémon to lead with, and Primarina seems favorable for a broad matchup. Let's finalize the order of my choices!

decisions.thought: Opponent has Dragonite, Kingambit, Gholdengo, Gliscor, Primarina, Incineroar. Garchomp's Earthquake hits 4/6 super effectively (Kingambit, Gholdengo, Primarina, Incineroar), neutral on Dragonite, misses Gliscor. Hydreigon with Choice Scarf outspeeds all and can handle Gliscor. Toxapex walls and Toxics. Lead Garchomp to sweep.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Let me analyze the opponent's team and pick the best 3 Pokémon to bring.

- Dragonite (Dragon/Flying) - possible abilities: innerfocus, multiscale
- Kingambit (Dark/Steel) - possible abilities: defiant, supremeoverlord, pressure
- Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost) - possible ability: goodasgold
- Gliscor (Ground/Flying) - possible abilities: hypercutter, sandveil, poisonheal
- Primarina (Water/Fairy) - possible abilities: torrent, liquidvoice
- Incineroar (Fire/Dark) - possible abilities: blaze, intimidate

My team:
- Garchomp (Dragon/Ground) - Life Orb, Sandveil, 169 Speed
- Toxapex (Poison/Water) - Leftovers, Regenerator, 55 Speed
- Hydreigon (Dark/Dragon) - Choice Scarf, Levitate, 165 Speed
- Corviknight (Flying/Steel) - Metal Coat, Unnerve, 87 Speed
- Gardevoir (Psychic/Fairy) - Wise Glasses, Synchronize, 145 Speed

Let me think about what to bring:

Key threats on opponent's team:
- Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost): Resists a LOT. Weak to Ground and Fire. My Garchomp (Ground) hits it super effectively. Krookodile also hits with Ground.
- Kingambit (Dark/Steel): Weak to Fighting, Ground, Fire. Garchomp's Earthquake hits super effectively.
- Dragonite (Dragon/Flying): Weak to Ice, Rock, Fairy, Electric. My Hydreigon can hit with Dracometeor but that's neutral. Actually, Dragonite resists many things.
- Gliscor (Ground/Flying): Weak to Water, Ice, Rock, Bug. Toxapex hits with... well, it's a wall. Corviknight is Steel so it resists Gliscor's moves.
- Primarina (Water/Fairy): Weak to Poison, Ground, Electric, Fire. Garchomp hits with Earthquake super effectively. Krookodile too.
- Incineroar (Fire/Dark): Weak to Water, Ground, Fighting, Bug. Garchomp hits with Earthquake super effectively.

Garchomp is clearly the best lead - it hits most of their team super effectively with Earthquake:
- Dragonite: neutral (Dragon resists Ground? No, Dragon/Flying vs Ground = neutral)
- Kingambit: super effective (Ground > Steel)
- Gholdengo: super effective (Ground > Steel/Ghost)
- Gliscor: immune (Ground > Ground/Flying... wait, Gliscor is Ground/Flying. Ground moves are NOT effective against Ground types. So Earthquake does 0 damage to Gliscor.)
- Primarina: super effective (Ground > Water/Fairy)
- Incineroar: super effective (Ground > Fire/Dark)

So Garchomp hits 4 out of 6 super effectively, is neutral on Dragonite, and misses Gliscor.

Hydreigon with Choice Scarf at 165 Speed can lead or be a sweeper. It has Dracometeor (Dragon/Special, BP 130) which hits Dragonite neutrally but also hits Gholdengo super effectively (Dragon > Ghost? No... Dragon vs Steel/Ghost: Dragon is neutral to Steel and neutral to Ghost. So it's neutral). Dark Pulse hits Kingambit super effectively (Dark > Dark/Steel... wait, Dark moves are not effective against Dark types. So Dark Pulse does 0 damage to Kingambit.)

Actually let me reconsider. Hydreigon's Dark/Dragon typing:
- Dark Pulse vs Dragonite (Dragon/Flying): neutral
- Dark Pulse vs Kingambit (Dark/Steel): immune (Dark resists Dark)
- Dark Pulse vs Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost): super effective (Dark > Ghost)
- Dark Pulse vs Gliscor (Ground/Flying): neutral
- Dark Pulse vs Primarina (Water/Fairy): neutral
- Dark Pulse vs Incineroar (Fire/Dark): immune

Dracometeor:
- Dragonite: neutral
- Kingambit: neutral
- Gholdengo: neutral
- Gliscor: neutral
- Primarina: neutral
- Incineroar: neutral

So Hydreigon is good but not the best sweeper here.

Krookodile (Ground/Dark) with Black Belt:
- Earthquake hits Kingambit, Gholdengo, Primarina, Incineroar super effectively
- Knockoff hits Dragonite, Gliscor, Primarina, Incineroar
- Payback is weak (50 BP)

Corviknight (Flying/Steel):
- Great defensive pivot
- Resists a lot of things
- Body Press can hit some things
- Defog clears hazards
- But it's slow (87 Speed) and has low offensive stats

Toxapex:
- Great wall
- Can Toxic, Recover, Baneful Bunker, Haze
- Slow (55 Speed)
- Good for stalling

Gardevoir (Psychic/Fairy):
- Moonblast hits Dragonite super effectively (Fairy > Dragon/Flying)
- Knockoff can remove items
- But weak to many things

Let me think about the best 3:

Option 1: Garchomp, Hydreigon, Toxapex
- Garchomp sweeps most of their team with Earthquake
- Hydreigon with Choice Scarf can outspeed and hit with Dracometeor or Dark Pulse
- Toxapex as a wall/stall option

Option 2: Garchomp, Krookodile, Toxapex
- Two Ground-types might be redundant
- But both hit most of their team super effectively

Option 3: Garchomp, Hydreigon, Corviknight
- Garchomp sweeps
- Hydreigon as fast sweeper
- Corviknight as defensive pivot with Defog

Option 4: Garchomp, Krookodile, Corviknight
- Garchomp and Krookodile both hit most of their team
- Corviknight as pivot

I think Option 1 (Garchomp, Hydreigon, Toxapex) is the strongest. Garchomp is the main sweeper, Hydreigon with Choice Scarf can handle threats that Garchomp can't (like Gliscor - though Earthquake misses Gliscor, Hydreigon's Dracometeor hits it neutrally), and Toxapex provides a wall and stall option.

Actually wait - let me reconsider. Gliscor is Ground/Flying. Garchomp's Earthquake does 0 damage to Gliscor. What can hit Gliscor?
- Hydreigon: Dracometeor (neutral), Dark Pulse (neutral)
- Krookodile: Payback (Dark, neutral), Knockoff (Dark, neutral)
- Toxapex: doesn't have a good move against Gliscor... Toxic would work though
- Corviknight: Body Press (Fighting, super effective! Flying resists Fighting? No wait. Gliscor is Ground/Flying. Fighting vs Flying = super effective. So Body Press hits Gliscor super effectively!)
- Gardevoir: Moonblast (Fairy, neutral), Knockoff (Dark, neutral)

So Corviknight's Body Press is the only super effective move against Gliscor on my team. That makes Corviknight more valuable.

But Toxapex can Toxic Gliscor and stall it out. And Garchomp + Hydreigon can handle everything else.

Let me also consider: what if they lead with Dragonite?
- Garchomp vs Dragonite: Earthquake is neutral, Dragonclaw is neutral. Garchomp wins speed (169 vs up to 145).
- Hydreigon vs Dragonite: Dracometeor neutral, Dark Pulse neutral. Hydreigon outspeeds with Choice Scarf.

What if they lead with Kingambit?
- Garchomp vs Kingambit: Earthquake super effective (Ground > Steel). Garchomp wins speed (169 vs up to 112).
- This is great for Garchomp.

What if they lead with Gholdengo?
- Garchomp vs Gholdengo: Earthquake super effective (Ground > Steel/Ghost). Garchomp wins speed (169 vs up to 149).
- Great for Garchomp.

I'll go with Garchomp, Hydreigon, Toxapex. This gives me:
- A fast sweeper that hits most of their team super effectively (Garchomp)
- A Choice Scarf user that can handle threats and outspeed everything (Hydreigon)
- A stall/wall option with Toxic and recovery (Toxapex)

This is a solid balanced team.
